name: Mapchise
oneLiner: Restaurant data analytics platform that combines POS, loyalty, marketing, pricing, competitor and mobility data for customer insights, attribution and site selection.
bestFor: Multi-unit restaurant groups and franchisors that want customer and location analytics (trade areas, white space, menu and pricing) built on their own POS and loyalty data.
features: Customer data platform that unifies POS, online ordering and loyalty data into guest profiles
Customer Explorer and customer maps showing where guests come from
Mobility (foot traffic) data on diner movement and demand trends
White-space analysis and site selection, including radius exclusion zones for franchise territories
Menu analytics, for example spotting combos that cannibalize higher-margin items
Built to handle multi-group and franchisor ownership structures

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Mapchise does not publish prices.

notes: Only Mapchise's own pages surfaced; no independent reviews, press coverage, named customers or dated 2025/2026 updates found. Its case studies are anonymous (a pizza brand, a regional sandwich shop, a restaurant group). The current review frames it as a 'guest data & revenue attribution' platform; Mapchise's site leans more toward location intelligence, site selection and market analytics, with the CDP as one module.
